budgets.about: The size budget per section that tools/budget_check.mjs checks (proposed by the engine round, 2026-10-12, from S6 inner_city, S5 gate and S4 outer_road part 1 as shipped with KTX2 textures, plus headroom). A new section must PASS before it joins the world. The page holds three sections at once (yours and each neighbour, web/src/world.js), so the window budget is what a phone holds: about 200 MB of sections, plus the fixed render targets (about 60 MB on a phone at the 1.5 pixel-ratio cap), plus 100-150 MB of JS, well under the 1-1.5 GB at which an iPhone Safari tab dies. Measured on the desktop GPU, where ETC1S copies become BC7 (8 bits a pixel; a phone gets ETC1, 4); the texture MB estimates use the phone's formats.

section.download_mb_why: the section's GLB, its layout/people/scene/backdrop JSON, its panels and the tree cards it plants (KTX2 where adopted): 4.8 / 7.7 / 7.5 MB now, the cards 2.5-5.4 of it
section.download_with_shared_mb_why: plus the kit swatches its GLB uses and every character and animal it casts (GLB + KTX2 copies): 15.3 / 16.0 / 16.4 MB now; the first visit's worst case, shared things come from cache after
section.triangles_k_why: drawn triangles: 119.5k / 107.2k / 109.6k now; the web-scene skill's budget (about 38 per m2 at full detail, 130k for a 74 x 46 m section)
section.collider_triangles_k_why: collider-only (hidden__) meshes: 0.6-1.2k now; invisible walls, trunks and ramps are boxes, not meshes
section.texture_own_mb_why: its panels and tree cards on the GPU (KTX2): 7.8 / 18.3 / 15.0 MB now; 69 MB for the gate as webp, so a section that ships cards without running tools/ktx2.mjs fails here
section.people_why: every painted figure and animal (map/BUILDING.md): the painting sets the number, reported only (197 / 93 / 81 now)
section.draw_calls_why: all passes (colour, ink normals, shadow) at its worst camera spot, alone: 278 / 224 / 215 now
section.gpu_mb_why: measured alone in a headless load (web/src/gpumem.js) once the crowd's bakes are done, minus the fixed render targets: 59.7 / 46.7 / 49.4 MB now (122-131 MB as webp)

window.gpu_mb_why: the most three neighbouring sections take together (each measured alone, so characters and kit shared between them are counted twice: an upper bound): 156 MB now
